sentences.ar: بالمدرسة، توم تأخر وقال السبب: كنت مع هَك.
sentences.en: At school, Tom was late and said why: I was with Huck.
The teacher hit him and seated him with the girls.

sentences.ar: قعد جنب بيكي وهو مبسوط بالعقاب.
sentences.en: He sat beside Becky, pleased with the punishment.

sentences.ar: رسم لها بيت صغير على لوح.
sentences.en: He drew her a small house on a slate.
He wrote to her: I love you.

sentences.ar: هي قرت وخبت وجهها وقالت: يا شقي.
sentences.en: She read it and hid her face and said: you rascal.
